title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: How to bulk import marketing text to items – Customization
summary: The post explains how to bulk import marketing text for items in Business Central using a custom XMLPORT and CSV file. It covers the difference between marketing text and item descriptions, the underlying Entity Text system table, and provides complete AL code for importing large text values that exceed typical field size limits.
key_points: Marketing text is richer, descriptive copy for items used in storefronts and customer communications, distinct from the concise Description field
Marketing text data is stored in system table 2000000132 (Entity Text), which cannot be imported via Configuration Packages
Custom AL code using XMLPORT with CSV format allows bulk import while handling large text values stored as Blob fields
The solution updates existing marketing text or inserts new records based on item number and company context
